instruction:
Open UniProtKB accession P04637 and report its entry name, recommended protein name, primary gene name, organism, sequence length, and reviewed status.

Stopping condition: Stop after all six requested identity and status fields have been recorded from the P04637 entry.

Constraints:
- Use only the specified UniProtKB entry.
- Use the main entry summary fields, not names mentioned in interaction or disease text.
- Report the primary gene name and canonical sequence length.
- Preserve capitalization and reviewed-status wording exactly as displayed.
